text:
Noah: quick pulse newwave-14b onboarding. We ran int6 vs int8 on longform doc-summarization (avg out ~1.3k). Cost delta looks nice but tail quality worries. Thoughts?

Tess: numbers + sample?

Noah: 1,600 examples, human pairwise n=260. eval-bot below.

eval-bot: |metric|int6|int8|delta|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|ROUGE-L|44.0|40.7|-3.3|
|BLEU|13.0|11.5|-1.5|
|Hallucination|3.6%|6.1%|+2.5pp|
|Cost/1k tok|$0.125|$0.082|-34%|

Arun: unit econ ~=34% savings. For 1.2M tokens/day ~ $40k/mo. But human pref on long docs: int6 64% vs int8 36% (p~0.02).

Tess: latency? int8 helps p50 ~9% but p95 same. So cost is main lever.

Noah: proposal: default int8 for short summaries and conversational routes; route predicted_complexity>0.5 OR expected_output>800 -> int6. Holdback 15% for 2w, GTN canary 5% first 48h. Fallback to int6 if hallucination > baseline +1pp for 4h.

Arun: Agree. Also shadow fp16 for VIP customers and collect counterexamples.

Noah: planned routing (stringified): {"routes":[{"cond":"expected_output>800 or pred_complexity>0.5","model":"newwave-14b-int6"},{"cond":"default","model":"newwave-14b-int8"}],"holdback_pct":"15","initial_canary_pct":"5","fallback":"newwave-14b-int6"}

Tess: I'll set up ROUGE drift (1.5pt), hallucination alert (+1pp), ngram-repetition monitor for >700 tokens and a small product qual panel next Wed.

devops-bot: rolling flag newwave-14b-routing-v1 scheduled for staging 07:30 PT tomorrow.
